```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
working_path = "~/iproject/BSReadSim/"

gc_bias_file = paste0(working_path, "/data/proc_data/ratio_depth_100/ratio_depth.csv")
gc_bias_rds  = paste0(working_path, "/data/proc_data/ratio_depth_100/ratio_depth.rds")

bool_rerun = FALSE
if(bool_rerun){
  gc_bias_df = read.table(gc_bias_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
  gc_bias_df = gc_bias_df %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(bin=cut(ratio, breaks = seq(0,1,0.01), include.lowest = TRUE))
  saveRDS(gc_bias_df, gc_bias_rds)
}else{
  gc_bias_df = readRDS(gc_bias_rds)
}
```


# boxplot remove outliers
```{r}
filter_data <- function(data, keep_chr = "chr21", col_name = "wgs_depth") {
  data %>% filter(if(!!keep_chr != "all") chr_id == keep_chr else TRUE) %>% 
    rename(tmp_value=col_name) %>% 
    group_by(bin) %>%
    mutate(outlier = ifelse(tmp_value < quantile(tmp_value, 0.25) - 1.5 * IQR(tmp_value) | 
                            tmp_value > quantile(tmp_value, 0.75) + 1.5 * IQR(tmp_value), TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
    filter(outlier == FALSE) %>%
    select(-outlier) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    rename(!!col_name := tmp_value)
}
```

```{r}
gc_bias_df_wgs_cleaned = filter_data(gc_bias_df, col_name = "wgs_depth", keep_chr = "chr21")
gc_bias_df_wgbs_cleaned= filter_data(gc_bias_df, col_name = "wgbs_depth",keep_chr = "chr21")
```

## lowess regression
```{r}
ggplot(gc_bias_df_wgbs_cleaned, aes(x=ratio, y=wgbs_depth)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "loess")
```




#test normality for each bin
```{r}
bin_rec_list = gc_bias_df_wgbs_cleaned
norm_test_df = data.frame(bin = bin_rec_list, wgbs_pval = NA, wgs_pval = NA) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("bin")
  
for(bin_rec in bin_rec_list){
  test_wgs_res = gc_bias_df_wgs_cleaned %>% 
    dplyr::filter(bin == bin_rec) %>% pull(wgs_depth) %>% 
    shapiro.test()
  test_wgbs_res= gc_bias_df_wgbs_cleaned %>% 
    dplyr::filter(bin == bin_rec) %>% pull(wgbs_depth) %>% 
    shapiro.test()
  
  norm_test_df[bin_rec, c("wgs_pval", "wgbs_pval")] = c(test_wgs_res$p.value, test_wgbs_res$p.value)
} 
```


```{r}
ggplot(gc_bias_df_wgbs_cleaned, aes(x=ratio, y=wgbs_depth) ) +
    geom_boxplot(fill="#69b3a2")
```


# depth ~ ratio (wgs)
```{r}
ggplot(gc_bias_df) +
  geom_point(aes(x=ratio, y=wgs_depth)) +
  stat_density2d(aes(fill = ..density..^0.25), geom = "tile", contour = FALSE, n = 200) +   
  scale_fill_continuous(low = "white", high = "dodgerblue4") +
  theme_bw()
```
